The common closed first/second moment ODEs give exact finite-time equality. Synchronous contraction yields unique invariant laws, with a strictly positive-definite stationary Cauchy matrix. The standalone exact rational check passed 21140 assertions; these are only corroboration.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp counterexample to inferring distributional fidelity from exact low-order moment agreement for a natural weak-reset diffusion surrogate. The contrast persists in any dimension at least two even with full-rank covariance, and the nonstandard one-Brownian density proof and Cauchy rank formula explain why. All-rate degree-two exactness, the cubic boundary and maximal TV obstruction jointly answer a motivated fidelity question; the result is not a routine known-table recomputation.
